news.title: Apple Unveils HomeView Hub as Part of Smart Home Push
news.description: Apple unveiled a new smart home device called HomeView, which highlights Siri AI and lets you control a range of soon-to-be-available cameras and thermostats. Chris Welch has more  (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Apple releases HomeView smart home hub with screen as showcase for Siri AI
news.description: The iPhone maker also announced the new Apple TV 4K and HomePod Mini.

news.title: Nvidia’s Huang Plans $2 Billion in Europe AI Deals in Next Week
news.description: Nvidia Corp. is planning to announce $2 billion in European investments in the next week, Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang said at an event in Paris on the first day of a tour that will also bring him to London and Berlin.

news.title: 不能打电话、发短信：华为官网显示手机与手机间通信共享只支持共享网络能力（含 eSIM）
news.description: IT之家 10 月 13 日消息，华为在 Mate 90 系列手机上首发了多设备互助通信共享功能。只需要碰一碰，就能把几台华为设备的网络资源整合起来，按需分配。

news.title: Iran reportedly fortifies nuclear sites as it prepares for possible U.S. strikes after midterms
news.description: A Saudi-led coalition fighting the Houthis – a Yemeni militant group backed by Tehran – said it had intercepted another attack on Riyadh.

news.title: 苹果今日举办欢迎回家发布会，盘中股价再创历史新高
news.description:
IT之家 10 月 13 日消息，苹果于北京时间 10 月 13 日晚 9 点召开了一次主题为“欢迎回家”的新品发布会，正式推出旗下首款智能家庭中枢 HomeView，以及 HomePod mini 2 等新品。

当晚美股盘初，苹果股价再度创下历史新高，总市值达 5.06 万亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 33.93 万亿元人民币）。

news.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle resigns as ambassador to Greece at White House's request
news.description: The White House had asked U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle to resign, press secretary Katie Zacharia said Tuesday in her debut briefing.

news.title: Paul Tudor Jones says 2027 could be a really challenging year for the stock market
news.description: The billionaire investor said that corporate buybacks, along with mergers and acquisitions, that have been a tail wind for the bull market are about to turn.

news.title: Martin Shkreli violated lifetime pharma industry ban, FTC and states say in contempt claim
news.description: Shkreli was banned from the pharmaceutical industry after a trial found that he organized an illegal scheme to perpetuate a monopoly for the drug Daraprim.

news.title: Chip Selloff Rolls On as Big Bank Earnings Begin
news.description:
A selloff in chipmakers deepened on concerns about the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence trade, putting pressure on equity markets as Wall Street banks kicked off the earnings season.
Lori Calvasina, Head of US Equity Strategy at RBC Capi

news.description: IT之家 10 月 13 日消息，红魔游戏手机官方今日继续预热 12 系列新机。据介绍，红魔 12 Pro+ 将采用红魔第九代屏下技术，打造无孔全面屏，宣称“通透度更高、刷新率更高、边框更窄”。

news.title: UnitedHealth Group tops estimates, hikes profit outlook as insurer manages high medical costs
news.description: UnitedHealth Group said it expects 2026 adjusted earnings of at least $20.50 per share, up from a previous outlook of $19.50 to $20.00 per share.

news.title: 零散小船赢不了航母巡洋舰！“中国刻蚀机之父”尹志尧提醒国内半导体设备企业不能散兵游勇式发展
news.description: IT之家 10 月 13 日消息，第 26 届中国国际工业博览会昨日于上海开幕。在集成电路高峰论坛上，中微公司董事长兼总经理尹志尧在分析行业趋势时表示，全球半导体设备市场从 2010 年至今整体持续增长。

news.title: Anthropic to disclose new revenue numbers as AI lab financials become central to tech trade
news.description: Anthropic will release updated financials to a group of investors gathering at its headquarters this week, according to people familiar with the matter.

news.title: 苹果智能家庭中枢 HomeView 细节：壁挂版不含支架得另买，可选 USB-C / 交流电 / PoE 版
news.description:
IT之家 10 月 13 日消息，苹果首款智能家庭中枢 HomeView 现已正式发布，除了配备扬声器底座的版本外，苹果还推出了一款壁挂版本，定价均为 299 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 2,005 元人民币）。
